newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria c.bank to hold Zunk bonds auction Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria c.bank to hold Zunk bonds auction Tuesday.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said on Monday it will hold another secondary auction of two issues of domestic bad debt bonds or Zunks, on Tuesday after the first such auction fell through a week earlier.
"Zunk bond issues 98/93 and 97/94 will be offered at an auction on July 22," the BNB said.
Financial institutions now trade lev- and dollar denominated Zunks on bilateral basis.

No deals were struck at the first Zunk bond secondary auction on July 15 due to low interest from the seller side, the short-notice auction announcement and the requirement for banks to place only one bid on behalf of a client.

Issue 98/93 is denominated in levs and its par value in circulation was 13.482 billion levs at end-June. The issue numbered 97/94 is denominated in dollars and its par in circulation stood at $892 million at the end of last month.
The settlement date for the auction is July 24, the BNB added.
Only financial institutions that are primary dealers of government securities can take part in the auction, the statement said.
Other companies, individuals and financial institutions may take part in the auction through orders placed with the primary dealers.
Participants in the auction can place only one order on their behalf and one order on behalf of each of their clients. They should also set a maximum buy price or a minimum sell price.
Sell orders at the Zunk bonds auction are irrevocable, the BNB said.

Bulgaria's government scrapped last month minimum prices for Zunks, as part of pledges to free trade. Local banks traded dollar-denominated ZUNKs at 67.5-90 percent of par last week and lev-denominated bonds at 58-76 percent of par.

The bonds were issued in 1993 and 1994 against unperforming debts of local state enterprises to state banks accumulated by 1991. The paper is accepted as means of payment at par value in local sell-offs. The BNB said it will inform the primary dealers on the buyer side for the auction results by the close of day on July 22.
